{"notes": "Visit 6 (left at 8:00). Table: the nose is still open. The bottom line ends near (3.5, 10) and the top near (4.3, 9.5), with no domino bridging them, so the gap is about 1 unit, the same as at visit 5. The three pale strays are still unconnected: the top loop arc (x 24-25, y 4-4.5), the tail (25, 14.5) and (7.9, 13). The bottom body (x 10-23, y 11-15) is still very dense and jammed, so the collapse risk remains. The team is now hands-off until the push. I still can't attribute any placement, so no build credit for anyone.

Omar: Said twice that the nose fix is 'closed' and that he's hands off. The picture doesn't show that, so his report was inaccurate or at best unverified. Earlier he was communicative and spotted the gap well, but a wrong 'all clear' is a real execution and accuracy concern. Ask him what he actually placed.

Hana: Called it 'looks good' and ordered a hands-off. Clear and decisive, but she signed off with the nose open, the strays unlifted and the jam untouched, and she relied on Omar's report without checking it. Leadership is good on direction and weaker on verification. Ask whether she saw the gap herself.

Sofia: Not seen or heard this visit. Still no follow-through seen on the strays. Ask her privately what she built and lifted.

Jack: Silent for a fourth visit. I still don't know what he built or whether he made the pale bits. Ask him privately.

Review: I'll rate on what I saw plus the private answers, and not on the team's own claims of success."}
